translations.adaptations: Specialized to default tblastn. Original do_sum_stats branch calls translated BLAST_LinkHsps; alternative calls original HSPListGetEvalues with gapped=true, scaling1, decay0. Protein/blastx-only composition P-value adjustment is omitted because original source never executes it for tblastn. Typed references replace C pointer preconditions; missing required linked-stat/option state remains an assertion.

integration: Expose protein_redo and export redo_protein_subject/ProteinRedoSubject/ProteinRedoError if desired. No shared edits were made.

redo_protein_subject(&ProteinInitialSearch, &NucleotideSequence, oid, ProteinPreliminarySubject) consumes preliminary owners and returns query_lists indexed by context plus best_scores, the original scaled score used as the composition-heap tie key before normalization. Native default tblastn has one context per query.

Native orchestration binds original Blast_RedoAlignmentCore per-query stages rather than claiming a complete one-to-one port of its multithreaded/external-source function. It merges six subject frame lists using original score comparator, initializes scoped scaled32 score/statistics copies, prepares query compositions and BLOSUM62 matrix/workspace, performs actual Blast_RedoOneMatch and HSP conversion, removes source-contained HSPs, calls original linked or unlinked E-values, reaps, normalizes and counts identities/positives.

CBS query data retain prepared masked contexts as in current source setup; final identities use original query and unmasked full-frame subject translations. On the focused pinned-tool smoke, masking CBS query gives source score253 while using original CBS query changes score257; source original residue reporting requires60 identities rather than masked51. This adapter behavior is recorded and needs broader end-to-end confirmation.
The source score block points at the last composition-adjusted matrix when counting positives; Native likewise binds the last adjusted matrix after redo and before final positives counting.

Only standard CBS2, NCBIstdaa protein queries, standard genetic code1 and ordinary non-OOF tblastn are supported. Existing original do_sum_stats/link parameters are used; no placeholder linking is substituted.

Database-level composition heap insertion/early termination, result collection/sorting, subject coordinate formatting and cross-platform/full-search parity/speed gates remain parent integration work. Parent should use result.best_scores[query] for the scaled tie key; normalized HSP score is not an equivalent tie key.

Scoped Clone of BlastScoreBlk and owned scoring parameters replace source save/rescale/restore mutation, retaining initial-search owner state. Matrix row binding and full frame identity translation are explicit ownership adapters, not new search algorithms.
native_context_reuse: ProteinRedoContext borrows immutable search setup and owns per-search/thread scaled ScoreBlk/scoring, redo params/matrix info, masked query composition and words, workspace, flat adjusted matrix, alignment vectors and traceback DP arenas. redo_subject binds only current borrowed subject/genetic code to callbacks, returning scratch on success/error. No unsafe/self-reference or new upstream function mappings; existing single-subject wrapper creates one context. Actual database-wide six-subject reuse preserves all11 tblastn smoke hits and reported fields/order/statistics at CLI precision.
partial_translation_update: The previous whole-frame identity shortcut is superseded: s_ComputeNumIdentities now uses original BlastTargetTranslationNew/GetTargetTranslation/Free cached windows. Native explicit slice-origin binding temporarily adjusts subject offsets only for the identity helper and restores them immediately. See target-translation.json.
